name: Apache Kafka
summary: Consume from and produce to Apache Kafka topics, and Kafka-compatible services: Redpanda, Amazon MSK, Confluent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud Kafka and Tencent CKafka.

auth.label: No client authentication (PLAINTEXT or plain TLS)

fields.name: username
fields.label: Username
fields.help: For Confluent Cloud, the API key.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: For Confluent Cloud, the API secret. Store it with ogun secrets set.

fields.name: client_key_pem
fields.label: Client private key (PEM)
fields.help: Store it with ogun secrets set.

settings.name: sasl_mechanism
settings.label: SASL mechanism
settings.help: Only with a SASL security protocol.

settings.name: start_offset
settings.label: Start offset
settings.help: Where a new consumer group starts.

egress.note: The hosts in bootstrap_servers, then the broker addresses they advertise; approve those too. 9092 is the Kafka default, 9093 is common for TLS.

operators.summary: Read records from a topic between recorded offsets and keep them as JSON lines.
Write records to a topic and record the partition and offset of each.

notes: Bridging records into Ogun's stream sources (O-09) is done by ogun-ingest and is not built for Kafka. MSK IAM authentication and OAUTHBEARER are not covered here.
